; Detailed MiniMap - English
; Key = text, UTF-8. A missing key falls back to en.txt, then to the key itself.
; Name is how the language is listed in the menu.

Intro = A detailed 3D map built from the world's real meshes: ground, houses, stairs, rocks, furniture.
Language = Language
Enabled = Map enabled
ToggleKey = Show / hide minimap:
